# Said Hasyim

> A personal brand hub dedicated to productivity, human performance, and personal development through innovative software products and the Peak book series.

Said Hasyim is a thought leader and entrepreneur focused on bridging technology and human potential. The site showcases productivity SaaS products (31Agent, 31Read, 31Trace, 31Memorize), the Peak Productivity book series covering circadian rhythms and cognitive enhancement, and philosophical insights on personal growth and AI readiness.

## Key Topics

- Peak Productivity Book Series
- 31Agent - AI Workflow Automation
- 31Read - Book Review Platform
- Circadian Rhythm Optimization
- Neuroplasticity & Brain Enhancement
- Self-Control & Habit Formation
- Personal Development
- AI Economy & Tech Education
- Biohacking Technology
- Philosophy & Human Behavior
- Software Products & SaaS
- Innovation & Productivity
- Thought Leadership
- Speaking & Mentorship
- Philanthropy & Social Impact

## Flagship Products

- [31Agent - Multi-AI Agent Workflows Engine](https://31agent.saidhasyim.com): AI workflow automation platform with multi-agent capabilities and integrations
- [31Read - Get More Book Reviews](https://31read.saidhasyim.com): Book review platform for authors across Amazon, Kobo, Google Play, and Goodreads
- [Top Software to Remain Productive](https://www.saidhasyim.com/software): Portfolio of SaaS products: 31Trace, 31Agent, 31Memorize, and productivity tools

## Peak Productivity Book Series

- [Peak Productivity Book Series - Unlock Your Peak Potential](https://www.saidhasyim.com/book): Peak Productivity book series covering Human Clock, Self-Control, Brain Plasticity, Mindset
- [Peak Human Clock - Fix Circadian Rhythm Disorder](https://www.saidhasyim.com/book/peak-human-clock): Peak Human Clock book on circadian rhythm optimization and sleep patterns
- [Peak Self-Control - Acquire Good Habits With Ease](https://www.saidhasyim.com/book/peak-self-control): Peak Self-Control book on willpower, habit formation, and self-discipline
- [Peak Brain Plasticity - Enhance Brain Function](https://www.saidhasyim.com/book/peak-brain-plasticity): Peak Brain Plasticity book on neuroplasticity, memory hacks, and cognitive enhancement
